title: O‘qish: asosiy g‘oyani topish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida notanish inglizcha matnni tez ko‘zdan kechirib, mavzu gapini topasiz, asosiy g‘oyani tafsilotdan ajratasiz va uni bitta gapda xulosa qila olasiz.

scenes.title: Asosiy g‘oyani topish
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda rasmiy va norasmiy xat yozishni o‘rgandik. Bugun o‘qish ko‘nikmasiga o‘tamiz. Matnni tez ko‘zdan kechirishni, mavzu gapini topishni, asosiy g‘oyani tafsilotdan ajratishni va matnni bitta gapda xulosa qilishni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida notanish matnni bir-ikki daqiqada o‘qib, uning asosiy fikrini ayta olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time we practised writing letters. Today we focus on reading. You will learn to skim a text, find the topic sentence and say the main idea in one clear sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar xat yozishni mashq qildik. Bugun o‘qishga e’tibor beramiz. Matnni ko‘zdan kechirishni, mavzu gapini topishni va asosiy g‘oyani bitta aniq gapda aytishni o‘rganasiz.

scenes.title: Skimming nima?
board: skimming = fast reading for the general idea

examples.t: I skimmed the article in two minutes.

scenes.say_native: Skimming, ya’ni tez ko‘zdan kechirish, matnning umumiy mazmunini tez bilib olish usulidir. Bunda har bir so‘zni o‘qimaysiz. Faqat sarlavha, ichki sarlavhalar, har bir abzatsning birinchi gapi va oxirgi abzatsga qaraysiz. O‘zbek tilida biz ko‘pincha matnni boshidan oxirigacha ketma-ket o‘qishga odatlanganmiz.
scenes.say: Skimming means reading quickly to get the general idea. You do not read every word. You look at the title, the headings, the first sentence of each paragraph and the ending.
scenes.say_uz: Skimming umumiy fikrni olish uchun tez o‘qishni anglatadi. Har bir so‘zni o‘qimaysiz. Sarlavhaga, har abzatsning birinchi gapiga va yakunga qaraysiz.

scenes.title: Skimming qadamlari
board: 4 Ask: what is this mostly about?
scenes.say_native: Skimming to‘rt qadamda bajariladi. Birinchi: sarlavha va rasmlarga qarang, matn nima haqida ekanini taxmin qiling. Ikkinchi: har bir abzatsning birinchi gapini o‘qing. Uchinchi: oxirgi abzatsni o‘qing, chunki xulosa ko‘pincha o‘sha yerda bo‘ladi. To‘rtinchi: o‘zingizdan so‘rang: bu matn asosan nima haqida?
scenes.say: Skim in four steps. Look at the title and pictures. Read the first sentence of each paragraph. Read the last paragraph. Then ask yourself: what is this text mostly about?
scenes.say_uz: Skimming to‘rt qadamda. Sarlavha va rasmlarga qarang. Har abzatsning birinchi gapini o‘qing. Oxirgi abzatsni o‘qing. Keyin so‘rang: bu matn asosan nima haqida?

scenes.title: Birinchi matn: uyqu va xotira
board: Many people think sleep is a waste of time.
In fact, sleep is essential for learning.
scenes.say_native: Mana birinchi matn. Hozir uni tez eshitib chiqing va umumiy fikrni toping. Bu matnni keyingi mashqlarda ham ishlatamiz, shuning uchun sarlavhaga va birinchi hamda oxirgi gaplarga alohida e’tibor bering. Matn kichik, lekin unda asosiy g‘oya ham, misol ham, maslahat ham bor.
scenes.say: Sleep and Memory. Many people think that sleep is a waste of time. In fact, scientists have found that sleep is essential for learning. While we sleep, the brain sorts the information from the day and stores the important parts. For example, students who sleep well after studying tend to remember more. So, if you want a better memory, protect your sleep.
scenes.say_uz: Uyqu va xotira. Ko‘pchilik uyquni vaqtni behuda sarflash deb o‘ylaydi. Aslida olimlar uyqu o‘rganish uchun muhim ekanini aniqlagan. Biz uxlaganimizda miya kun davomidagi ma’lumotni saralab, muhim qismini saqlaydi. Masalan, o‘qigandan keyin yaxshi uxlagan talabalar ko‘proq eslab qolishga moyil. Shuning uchun xotirangiz yaxshi bo‘lsin desangiz, uyquni asrang.

scenes.title: Skimming xatolari
board: ✓ Read for the big picture first
✓ Use a dictionary only after skimming
scenes.say_native: Eng katta xato: har bir so‘zni o‘qib, notanish so‘zda to‘xtash va lug‘atga yugurish. Bu tezlikni pasaytiradi va umumiy fikrni yo‘qotishga olib keladi. Ko‘pchilik o‘quvchi buni maktabdagi o‘qishdan olgan odat. Esingizda bo‘lsin: avval katta rasm, keyin tafsilotlar.
scenes.say: Do not read word by word, and do not stop at every new word. First get the big picture. You can use a dictionary after you skim.
scenes.say_uz: So‘zma-so‘z o‘qimang va har bir yangi so‘zda to‘xtamang. Avval umumiy rasmni oling. Lug‘atni skimmingdan keyin ishlating.

scenes.title: Taxmin qiling
board: Title: Why Cities Need More Trees
First lines: Trees cool the air. They clean it too.
scenes.say_native: Sarlavha: “Why Cities Need More Trees”. Birinchi gaplar: “Trees cool the air. They clean it too.” Faqat shu ma’lumotga tayanib, matn nima haqida ekanini taxmin qiling. Matnning umumiy mavzusini inglizcha bir ibora bilan ayting.
scenes.say: The title is Why Cities Need More Trees. The first lines say: Trees cool the air. They clean it too. What do you think the text is about?
scenes.say_uz: Sarlavha: Shaharlarga nima uchun ko‘proq daraxt kerak. Birinchi gaplar: Daraxtlar havoni salqinlatadi. Ular uni tozalaydi ham. Matn nima haqida deb o‘ylaysiz?

scenes.title: Javob
board: The benefits of trees in cities

examples.t: The text is about the benefits of trees in cities.

scenes.say_native: Javob: matn shaharlardagi daraxtlarning foydalari haqida. Siz uni bir daqiqa ham o‘ylamay, faqat sarlavha va ikkita gapdan topdingiz. Bu skimming kuchi. Albatta, taxmin keyin tekshiriladi: matnning qolgan qismi uni tasdiqlashi kerak. Agar tasdiqlamasa, taxminni o‘zgartirasiz.
scenes.say: The text is about the benefits of trees in cities. You can often predict the topic from the title and the first lines.
scenes.say_uz: Matn shaharlardagi daraxtlarning foydasi haqida. Mavzuni ko‘pincha sarlavha va birinchi gaplardan taxmin qilish mumkin.

scenes.title: Mavzu gapi
board: topic sentence = states the paragraph's main point
it is general; details are specific
scenes.say_native: Mavzu gapi, ya’ni topic sentence, abzatsning asosiy fikrini aytadigan gap. U umumiyroq bo‘ladi, qolgan gaplar esa uni misollar, raqamlar va sabablar bilan quvvatlaydi. Odatda mavzu gapi abzatsning boshida turadi, lekin ba’zan oxirida yoki o‘rtasida.
scenes.say: A topic sentence states the main point of a paragraph. It is general. The other sentences support it with examples, reasons and numbers. It is often first, but not always.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu gapi abzatsning asosiy fikrini aytadi. U umumiy bo‘ladi. Boshqa gaplar uni misol, sabab va raqamlar bilan quvvatlaydi. U ko‘pincha birinchi, lekin har doim emas.

scenes.title: Mavzu gapi qayerda?
board: Look again at the sleep text.
scenes.say_native: Uyqu haqidagi matnga qayting. Birinchi gap, “Many people think that sleep is a waste of time”, ko‘pchilik ishonadigan fikrni beradi, lekin muallif u bilan rozi emas. Haqiqiy mavzu gapi ikkinchi: “In fact, sleep is essential for learning”. “In fact” iborasi odatda muallifning haqiqiy fikrini ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: The first sentence gives a common belief. The writer does not agree. The real topic sentence is the second one: In fact, sleep is essential for learning.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi gap keng tarqalgan fikrni beradi. Muallif rozi emas. Haqiqiy mavzu gapi ikkinchi: In fact, sleep is essential for learning.

scenes.title: Qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi signal so‘zlar
board: For example · For instance · Such as
In fact · Actually → the real point

examples.t: For example, students who sleep well remember more.
examples.uz: Masalan, yaxshi uxlagan talabalar ko‘proq eslab qoladi.

scenes.say_native: Signal so‘zlar mavzu gapini topishga yordam beradi. “For example” va “for instance” dan keyin misol, ya’ni tafsilot keladi, asosiy g‘oya emas. “In fact” va “actually” haqiqiy fikrni ko‘rsatadi. “However” va “but” qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi, ko‘pincha undan keyin muallifning fikri keladi.
scenes.say: Signal words help. For example introduces a detail. In fact and actually often introduce the real point. However and but show contrast. So and therefore introduce a conclusion.
scenes.say_uz: Signal so‘zlar yordam beradi. For example tafsilotni boshlaydi. In fact va actually ko‘pincha haqiqiy fikrni boshlaydi. However va but qarama-qarshilikni, so va therefore xulosani ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Mavzu gapini adashtirish
board: ✗ Choose the sentence with an example
✓ Choose the general sentence the others support
scenes.say_native: Ikki odatiy xato. Birinchisi: mavzu gapini doim birinchi gap deb o‘ylash. Yuqoridagi matnda bu ishlamadi. Ikkinchisi: misol keltirilgan gapni asosiy deb tanlash. Misol faqat g‘oyani isbotlaydi. Tekshirish usuli oddiy: tanlagan gapingiz bo‘lsa, boshqa gaplar uni tushuntirib turadimi?
scenes.say: Do not always choose the first sentence. Do not choose an example. Choose the general sentence that the other sentences support.
scenes.say_uz: Doim birinchi gapni tanlamang. Misolni tanlamang. Boshqa gaplar quvvatlaydigan umumiy gapni tanlang.

scenes.title: Mavzu gapini toping
board: A) Cats sleep a lot. Some sleep sixteen hours a day. Cats are lazy only in appearance.
B) My town is small. There is one bakery. Everyone knows everyone.
Which sentence is the topic sentence?
scenes.say_native: Ikkita kichik abzats. Birinchisida uchta gap: mushuklar ko‘p uxlaydi, ba’zilari kuniga o‘n olti soat uxlaydi, mushuklar faqat ko‘rinishdan dangasa. Ikkinchisida: shaharcham kichik, bitta nonvoyxona bor, hamma hammani taniydi. Har birida mavzu gapi qaysi? Raqamini ayting.
scenes.say: Paragraph A: Cats sleep a lot. Some sleep sixteen hours a day. Cats are lazy only in appearance. Paragraph B: My town is small. There is one bakery. Everyone knows everyone. Find the topic sentence in each.
scenes.say_uz: A abzats: Mushuklar ko‘p uxlaydi. Ba’zilari kuniga o‘n olti soat uxlaydi. Mushuklar faqat ko‘rinishdan dangasa. B abzats: Shaharcham kichik. Bitta nonvoyxona bor. Hamma hammani taniydi. Mavzu gapini toping.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. A abzatsda mavzu gapi birinchi: “Cats sleep a lot”. Ikkinchi gap, kuniga o‘n olti soat, shu fikrni raqam bilan quvvatlaydi. Uchinchi gap esa mazmunni xulosalaydi. B abzatsda ham mavzu gapi birinchi: “My town is small”, qolgan ikkita gap, bitta nonvoyxona va hamma hammani taniydi, shaharchaning kichikligini isbotlaydi.
scenes.say: In A the topic sentence is Cats sleep a lot. In B it is My town is small. The other sentences give details.
scenes.say_uz: A da mavzu gapi Cats sleep a lot. B da My town is small. Qolgan gaplar tafsilot beradi.

scenes.title: Asosiy g‘oya va tafsilot
board: main idea = the point of the whole text
Test: remove it. Does the point change?

examples.uz: Asosiy g‘oya: uyqu xotiraga yordam beradi.
Tafsilot: talabalar ko‘proq faktni eslab qoladi.

scenes.say_native: Asosiy g‘oya, main idea, butun matnning asosiy fikri. Tafsilot, detail, esa uni quvvatlovchi misol, raqam, ism yoki sabab. Farqlash uchun oddiy sinov bor: bu gapni matndan olib tashlasam, matnning umumiy fikri o‘zgaradimi? Agar o‘zgarmasa, bu tafsilot.
scenes.say: The main idea is the point of the whole text. Details are examples, numbers, names and reasons. Try this test: if you remove the sentence, does the main point change? If not, it is a detail.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy g‘oya butun matnning fikri. Tafsilotlar misol, raqam, ism va sabablar. Sinab ko‘ring: gapni olib tashlasangiz, asosiy fikr o‘zgaradimi? O‘zgarmasa, bu tafsilot.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi matn: Millbrook
board: Twelve kilometres of new bike lanes
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi matn bir necha abzatsli maqolaning qisqartirilgan shakli. Tinglang va o‘zingizga so‘rang: bu matnning asosiy g‘oyasi nima, tafsilotlar qaysilar? Raqam, odamlar va natijaga e’tibor bering. Shuningdek, “However” so‘zi nima uchun kerak ekanini payqang.
scenes.say: Millbrook Goes Green. Last year, the town of Millbrook built twelve kilometres of new bike lanes. At first, many shop owners were worried that customers would stop coming. However, the opposite happened. Because the streets were quieter, more people stopped to shop. Today, the number of cyclists has doubled, and the mayor says the town is cleaner and friendlier.
scenes.say_uz: Millbrook yashillashmoqda. O‘tgan yili Millbrook shahri o‘n ikki kilometr yangi velosiped yo‘lagini qurdi. Avval ko‘plab do‘kon egalari mijozlar kelmay qo‘yishidan xavotirda edi. Biroq aksi bo‘ldi. Ko‘chalar tinchroq bo‘lgani uchun ko‘proq odam do‘konlarga kirdi. Bugun velosipedchilar soni ikki baravar oshdi, shahar hokimi esa shahar toza va do‘stona bo‘lganini aytmoqda.

scenes.title: Asosiy g‘oyani tanlang
board: B) The bike lanes have brought benefits to Millbrook.
C) Cars are bad for all cities.
scenes.say_native: Millbrook matni uchun uchta variant. A: do‘kon egalari xavotirda edi. B: velosiped yo‘lagi Millbrookka foyda keltirdi. C: mashinalar hamma shaharlar uchun yomon. Qaysi biri butun matnning asosiy g‘oyasi? Qaysi biri faqat tafsilot, qaysi biri esa matnda aytilmagan fikr? Javobingizni ayting.
scenes.say: Which is the main idea? A: Shop owners were worried. B: The bike lanes have brought benefits to Millbrook. C: Cars are bad for all cities.
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi biri asosiy g‘oya? A: Do‘kon egalari xavotirda edi. B: Velosiped yo‘lagi Millbrookka foyda keltirdi. C: Mashinalar hamma shaharlar uchun yomon.

scenes.title: Javob: B
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri javob B. U butun matnni qamrab oladi: velosiped yo‘lagi shaharga foyda keltirdi, do‘konlarga ham, havoga ham. A faqat tafsilot, matn boshidagi xavotirni aytadi, oxirida esa teskari bo‘lgan. C esa matnda hech qayerda yo‘q, bu muallifning fikri emas, o‘zimizning xulosamiz.
scenes.say: The answer is B. It covers the whole text. A is only a detail. C is not in the text at all.
scenes.say_uz: Javob B. U butun matnni qamrab oladi. A faqat tafsilot. C matnda umuman yo‘q.

scenes.title: Imtihon savollari turlari
board: What is the main idea of the text?
purpose: to inform · to persuade · to entertain
scenes.say_native: Imtihonda asosiy g‘oya haqida uch xil savol bo‘ladi: “What is the main idea?”, “What is the best title?” va “What is the writer’s purpose?”. Muallifning maqsadi uch xil: ma’lumot berish, ya’ni to inform; ishontirish, to persuade; ko‘ngil ochish, to entertain. Millbrook matni asosan ma’lumot beradi.
scenes.say: The exam asks about the main idea, the best title, or the writer's purpose. A writer may want to inform, to persuade or to entertain.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihon asosiy g‘oya, eng yaxshi sarlavha yoki muallif maqsadi haqida so‘raydi. Muallif ma’lumot bermoqchi, ishontirmoqchi yoki ko‘ngil ochmoqchi bo‘lishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Yolg‘on variantlar
board: ✗ Too big → the whole topic of the world
✓ Covers the whole text, no more, no less
scenes.say_native: Imtihondagi noto‘g‘ri variantlar uch xil bo‘ladi. Birinchisi: to‘g‘ri, lekin juda tor, ya’ni tafsilot. Ikkinchisi: juda keng, matn aytganidan ancha ortiq. Uchinchisi: matnda umuman yo‘q yoki teskarisi. To‘g‘ri variant esa matnni to‘liq, ortiqcha-kamsiz qamrab oladi.
scenes.say: Wrong options are often true but too small, too big, or not in the text. The correct option covers the whole text, no more and no less.
scenes.say_uz: Noto‘g‘ri variantlar ko‘pincha to‘g‘ri, lekin juda tor, juda keng yoki matnda yo‘q bo‘ladi. To‘g‘ri variant matnni ortiqcha-kamsiz qamraydi.

scenes.title: Eng yaxshi sarlavha
board: B) Why Sleep Matters for Learning
scenes.say_native: Uyqu matni uchun eng yaxshi sarlavhani tanlang. A: “Hours of Sleep”, uyqu soatlari. B: “Why Sleep Matters for Learning”. C: “Healthy Life”. Eslang: sarlavha matn haqida aniq, lekin hamma tafsilotni qamrab oluvchi bo‘lishi kerak. Javobingizni va sababini ayting.
scenes.say: Choose the best title for the sleep text. A: Hours of Sleep. B: Why Sleep Matters for Learning. C: Healthy Life.
scenes.say_uz: Uyqu matni uchun eng yaxshi sarlavhani tanlang. A: Uyqu soatlari. B: Uyqu nima uchun o‘rganishda muhim. C: Sog‘lom hayot.

scenes.title: Javob: B
board: A ✗ not in the text (no hours)
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri javob B. Matn uyqu o‘rganishga qanday yordam berishini tushuntiradi, B esa shuni aniq aytadi. A noto‘g‘ri, chunki matnda soatlar haqida gap yo‘q. C juda umumiy: sog‘lom hayot haqida son-sanoqsiz mavzu bo‘lishi mumkin. Yaxshi sarlavha matnning o‘ziga xosligini ko‘rsatadi, shunchaki mavzuga ishora qilmaydi.
scenes.say: B is correct. It names the topic and the point. A is not in the text. C is too general.
scenes.say_uz: B to‘g‘ri. U mavzuni ham, fikrni ham aytadi. A matnda yo‘q. C juda umumiy.

scenes.title: Bitta gapda xulosa
board: Summary = topic + the writer's main point
Formula: The text says that… / The writer argues that…

examples.t: The text explains that sleep helps us remember what we learn.
examples.uz: Matn uyqu o‘rganganimizni eslab qolishga yordam berishini tushuntiradi.

scenes.say_native: Endi xulosa. Bir gapli xulosa mavzuni va muallifning asosiy fikrini o‘z ichiga oladi. Formulasi: “The text explains that…” yoki “The writer argues that…” va ortidan asosiy fikr. Uzunligi taxminan o‘n besh–yigirma besh so‘z. Unda misollar, raqamlar va shaxsiy fikringiz bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: A one-sentence summary has the topic and the writer's main point. Use: The text explains that, or The writer argues that. Keep it to about fifteen to twenty-five words.
scenes.say_uz: Bir gapli xulosada mavzu va muallifning asosiy fikri bo‘ladi. The text explains that yoki The writer argues that dan foydalaning. Taxminan o‘n besh–yigirma besh so‘z yetarli.

scenes.title: O‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan
board: tend to remember more → remember better

examples.t: Sleep is essential. → Sleep is vital.

scenes.say_native: Xulosada muallifning gapini ko‘chirmaysiz, o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan aytasiz. Bunga paraphrasing deyiladi. Usullar: sinonim ishlatish, masalan “essential” o‘rniga “vital”; gap tuzilishini o‘zgartirish; ikki gapni bittaga birlashtirish. Mazmun o‘zgarmasligi shart.
scenes.say: Do not copy the writer. Paraphrase. Use synonyms, change the sentence structure, and keep the same meaning. For example, essential can become vital.
scenes.say_uz: Muallifni ko‘chirmang. Paraphrase qiling. Sinonimlar ishlating, gap tuzilishini o‘zgartiring, ma’noni saqlang. Masalan, essential vital bo‘lishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Xulosadagi xatolar
board: ✗ Adding your opinion: I think this is great
scenes.say_native: Xulosadagi uchta xato. Birinchisi: matndan gapni so‘zma-so‘z ko‘chirish. Ikkinchisi: o‘z fikrini qo‘shish, masalan “I think this is great”. Xulosa muallifning fikrini beradi, sizniki emas. Uchinchisi: ortiqcha tafsilotlar va raqamlar qo‘shish; xulosa qisqa bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say: Do not copy a sentence. Do not add your opinion. Do not include too many details. Write the topic and the main point in your own words.
scenes.say_uz: Gapni ko‘chirmang. O‘z fikringizni qo‘shmang. Ortiqcha tafsilot yozmang. Mavzu va asosiy fikrni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan yozing.

scenes.title: Millbrook xulosasi
board: Summarise the Millbrook text in one sentence.
scenes.say_native: Millbrook matnini bitta gapda xulosa qiling. “The text explains that” bilan boshlang. Eslang: mavzu shahar va velosiped yo‘lagi, asosiy fikr esa ular shaharga foyda keltirdi. Raqamlarni qo‘shmang. Javobingizni ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Summarise the Millbrook text in one sentence. Begin with: The text explains that.
scenes.say_uz: Millbrook matnini bitta gapda xulosa qiling. The text explains that bilan boshlang.

scenes.title: Namuna xulosa
board: The text explains that new bike lanes have made Millbrook cleaner and have even helped local shops.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “The text explains that new bike lanes have made Millbrook cleaner and have even helped local shops”. Bu gapda mavzu bor, ya’ni velosiped yo‘lagi va Millbrook, asosiy fikr ham bor, ya’ni foyda. Raqam, hokim va xavotir kabi tafsilotlar tushib qolgan.
scenes.say: The text explains that new bike lanes have made Millbrook cleaner and have even helped local shops. Notice that the numbers and details are missing.
scenes.say_uz: Matn yangi velosiped yo‘laklari Millbrookni toza qilgani va hatto mahalliy do‘konlarga yordam berganini tushuntiradi. Raqamlar va tafsilotlar tushib qolganiga e’tibor bering.

scenes.title: Uch gapli xulosa
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifangizda uch gapli xulosa so‘ralgan. Reja oddiy. Birinchi gap mavzu va asosiy g‘oyani beradi. Ikkinchi gap eng muhim dalil yoki muammoni aytadi. Uchinchi gap natija yoki xulosani beradi. Uch yuz so‘zli maqola bo‘lsa, taxminan har bir katta bo‘lim uchun bitta gap chiqadi.
scenes.say: For a three-sentence summary: first give the topic and main idea, then the key support or problem, then the result or conclusion. Link your sentences with simple connectors.
scenes.say_uz: Uch gapli xulosa uchun: avval mavzu va asosiy g‘oya, keyin asosiy dalil yoki muammo, keyin natija. Gaplarni oddiy bog‘lovchilar bilan ulang.

scenes.title: Tinglash: o‘n daqiqa vaqt
board: Q1: How much time does Nina have?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Talabalar Nina va Omar maqolani qanday o‘qish haqida gaplashmoqda. Tinglang va uch savolga javob toping: Ninaning qancha vaqti bor, u nimalarni o‘qishi kerak va notanish so‘zlarni nima qilish kerak?
scenes.say: I have ten minutes to read this article. Do I have to read every word? No. Read the title, the first sentence of each paragraph and the last paragraph. Then ask what the main point is. And if there is a word I don't know? Keep going. Often you don't need it.
scenes.say_uz: Bu maqolani o‘qishga menda o‘n daqiqa bor. Har bir so‘zni o‘qishim kerakmi? Yo‘q. Sarlavhani, har abzatsning birinchi gapini va oxirgi abzatsni o‘qi. Keyin asosiy fikr nima ekanini so‘ra. Notanish so‘z bo‘lsa-chi? Davom et. Ko‘pincha u kerak bo‘lmaydi.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: Q1: How much time does Nina have?
Q3: What about a new word?
scenes.say_native: Uch savol. Birinchi: Ninaning qancha vaqti bor? Ikkinchi: Omar nimalarni o‘qishni maslahat beradi? Uchinchi: notanish so‘z uchrasa nima qilish kerak? Xotirangizdan javob bering.
scenes.say: Question one: how much time does Nina have? Question two: what should she read? Question three: what should she do about a new word?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Ninaning qancha vaqti bor? Ikki: u nimani o‘qishi kerak? Uch: yangi so‘z bilan nima qilish kerak?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Ninaning o‘n daqiqasi bor. Ikkinchi: sarlavha, har abzatsning birinchi gapi va oxirgi abzats. Uchinchi: davom etish, chunki notanish so‘z ko‘pincha asosiy fikr uchun zarur emas. Omarning maslahati bugungi darsning qisqa xulosasi.
scenes.say: Nina has ten minutes. She should read the title, the first sentences and the last paragraph. For a new word, she should keep going.
scenes.say_uz: Ninaning o‘n daqiqasi bor. U sarlavhani, birinchi gaplarni va oxirgi abzatsni o‘qishi kerak. Yangi so‘z uchrasa, davom etishi kerak.

scenes.title: Notanish so‘z: kontekst
board: Which part of speech? noun · verb · adjective
Positive or negative? Similar or opposite?

examples.t: The road was so congested that it took two hours.
examples.uz: Yo‘l shu qadar gavjum ediki, ikki soat ketdi.

scenes.say_native: Notanish so‘zni lug‘atsiz tushunish mumkin. Atrofdagi gaplarga qarang. So‘z qaysi turkumga kiradi: ot, fe’l yoki sifat? Ma’nosi ijobiymi yoki salbiy? Atrofidagi so‘zlar o‘xshashmi yoki qarama-qarshimi? Masalan: “The road was so congested that it took two hours”.
scenes.say: You can guess a new word from context. Look at the words around it. Decide if it is a noun, a verb or an adjective. Ask if the meaning is positive or negative.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi so‘zni kontekstdan taxmin qilsa bo‘ladi. Atrofdagi so‘zlarga qarang. U ot, fe’l yoki sifatligini aniqlang. Ma’nosi ijobiy yoki salbiyligini so‘rang.

scenes.title: So‘z ma’nosini toping
board: 1) She is very frugal; she never buys things she doesn't need.
A) careful with money B) very rich C) lazy
scenes.say_native: Gap: “She is very frugal; she never buys things she doesn’t need”. “Frugal” so‘zi nimani anglatadi? A: pulni ehtiyotkorlik bilan sarflaydigan. B: juda boy. C: dangasa. Nuqtali vergul keyingi qism sababni tushuntiryapti. Javobingizni va qaysi so‘zlar yordam berganini ayting.
scenes.say: She is very frugal; she never buys things she doesn't need. What does frugal mean? A: careful with money. B: very rich. C: lazy.
scenes.say_uz: U juda frugal; hech qachon keraksiz narsa sotib olmaydi. Frugal nimani anglatadi? A: pulga ehtiyotkor. B: juda boy. C: dangasa.

scenes.title: Javob: A
board: clue: never buys things she doesn't need
scenes.say_native: Javob A: pulga ehtiyotkor. Maslahat so‘zlar: “never buys things she doesn’t need”, ya’ni keraksiz narsa olmaydi. Bu boy bo‘lish yoki dangasalik haqida emas. Ko‘rdingizmi, so‘zni bilmasdan ham ma’noni topdingiz. Imtihonda ham ayni shu usul ishlaydi va asosiy g‘oyani tushunishga to‘sqinlik qilmaydi.
scenes.say: The answer is A. The clue is: she never buys things she doesn't need. So frugal means careful with money.
scenes.say_uz: Javob A. Maslahat: u keraksiz narsa sotib olmaydi. Demak, frugal pulga ehtiyotkorlikni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kalit so‘zlar urg‘usi
board: Weak: the · a · of · is · to
In FACT, SCIentists have FOUND that SLEEP is esSENtial for LEARNing.
scenes.say_native: Eshitganda ham asosiy g‘oyani topish mumkin. Ingliz tilida gapda ma’noli so‘zlar, ya’ni otlar, fe’llar va sifatlar urg‘u oladi, “the”, “a”, “of”, “is”, “to” kabi yordamchi so‘zlar esa kuchsiz va qisqa talaffuz qilinadi. Masalan: “In FACT, SCIentists have FOUND that SLEEP is esSENtial for LEARNing”.
scenes.say: In English, the important words are stressed: nouns, verbs and adjectives. Small words like the, a and of are weak. In fact, scientists have found that sleep is essential for learning. The stressed words give the main idea.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilida muhim so‘zlar urg‘u oladi: otlar, fe’llar, sifatlar. The, a, of kabi kichik so‘zlar kuchsiz. Urg‘u olgan so‘zlar asosiy g‘oyani beradi.

scenes.title: Uchinchi matn: uydan ishlash
board: Many firms: some days at home
scenes.say_native: Oxirgi matn bilan mustaqil ishlaysiz. Uni diqqat bilan tinglang. Sarlavhani eslang: “Working from Home”. Matn nechta fikrni solishtirayotganiga, qaysi biri xodimlarniki, qaysi biri rahbarlarniki ekaniga va oxirida qanday kelishuv taklif qilinganiga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Working from Home. Many companies now let employees work from home for part of the week. Workers say they save time and money because they do not travel every day. Managers, however, worry that teams may talk less. Some firms have found a compromise: two days at home and three in the office. This way, people keep the flexibility and the team spirit.
scenes.say_uz: Uydan ishlash. Ko‘p kompaniyalar xodimlarga haftaning bir qismida uydan ishlashga ruxsat beradi. Xodimlar har kuni qatnamagani uchun vaqt va pulni tejashini aytadi. Biroq rahbarlar jamoa kam gaplashishidan xavotirda. Ba’zi firmalar kelishuv topgan: ikki kun uyda, uch kun ofisda. Shu tarzda odamlar erkinlikni ham, jamoa ruhini ham saqlaydi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa
board: Say the main idea of the text in ONE sentence.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa. Uchinchi matnning asosiy g‘oyasini bitta gapda ayting. “The text explains that” bilan boshlang, o‘z so‘zlaringizni ishlating. Avval xodimlarning va rahbarlarning fikrini, keyin kelishuvni o‘ylang. Bu uchala narsani bitta gapga sig‘dirishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Say the main idea of the Working from Home text in one sentence. Start with: The text explains that. Use your own words.
scenes.say_uz: Uydan ishlash matnining asosiy g‘oyasini bitta gapda ayting. The text explains that bilan boshlang va o‘z so‘zlaringizni ishlating.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: The text explains that many companies let staff work from home part of the week to balance flexibility and teamwork.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “The text explains that many companies let staff work from home part of the week to balance flexibility and teamwork”. Bu gapda mavzu bor, ya’ni uydan ishlash, va asosiy fikr ham bor, ya’ni erkinlik va jamoa ruhini muvozanatlash. Ikki kun uyda, uch kun ofisda kabi raqamlar tafsilot sifatida tushib qolgan.
scenes.say: The text explains that many companies let staff work from home part of the week to balance flexibility and teamwork. The numbers are details, so they are not needed.
scenes.say_uz: Matn ko‘p kompaniyalar xodimlarga haftaning bir qismida uydan ishlashga ruxsat berib, erkinlik va jamoa ishini muvozanatlashini tushuntiradi. Raqamlar tafsilot, shuning uchun kerak emas.

scenes.title: Tinglash: o‘qituvchi va xulosa
board: Q1: Why is the teacher not happy?
Q2: How long should the summary be?
Q3: What must Karim not do?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash. O‘qituvchi Karimning xulosasini tekshirmoqda. Karim nimani noto‘g‘ri qilganini va o‘qituvchi nimani talab qilishini eshiting. Uch savol: o‘qituvchi nega norozi, xulosa qancha bo‘lishi kerak va Karim nimani qilmasligi kerak?
scenes.say: Karim, your summary is nearly two hundred words long. It should be one sentence. But I included all the details. Details belong in the text. A summary gives only the main idea. Should I copy the writer's sentence? No, please put it in your own words.
scenes.say_uz: Karim, xulosangiz deyarli ikki yuz so‘z. U bitta gap bo‘lishi kerak. Lekin men hamma tafsilotni kiritdim. Tafsilotlar matnning o‘zida bo‘ladi. Xulosa faqat asosiy fikrni beradi. Muallifning gapini ko‘chiraymi? Yo‘q, uni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan ayting.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: Q1: Why is the teacher not happy?
Q2: How long should it be?
Q3: What must Karim not do?
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Birinchi: o‘qituvchi nega norozi? Ikkinchi: xulosa qancha bo‘lishi kerak? Uchinchi: Karim nimani qilmasligi kerak? Xotirangizdan ayting.
scenes.say: Question one: why is the teacher not happy? Question two: how long should the summary be? Question three: what must Karim not do?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: o‘qituvchi nega norozi? Ikki: xulosa qancha bo‘lishi kerak? Uch: Karim nimani qilmasligi kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: xulosa juda uzun, deyarli ikki yuz so‘z. Ikkinchi: u bitta gap bo‘lishi kerak. Uchinchi: Karim muallifning gapini ko‘chirmasligi kerak, uni o‘z so‘zlarida aytishi lozim. Bu dialog bugungi darsning uchta xatosini birlashtirdi: ortiqcha tafsilot, uzun xulosa va ko‘chirish.
scenes.say: The summary was too long, nearly two hundred words. It should be one sentence. Karim must not copy the writer's sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa juda uzun edi, deyarli ikki yuz so‘z. U bitta gap bo‘lishi kerak. Karim muallifning gapini ko‘chirmasligi kerak.

scenes.title: Imtihon strategiyasi
board: Check each option against the text
scenes.say_native: Imtihon uchun vaqt rejasi. Birinchi daqiqada skimming qiling va asosiy g‘oyani taxmin qiling. Keyingi ikki daqiqada savollar so‘ragan joylarni diqqat bilan o‘qing. Javob variantlarini taxmin bilan emas, matn bilan solishtiring: har bir variantni matnga qarab tekshiring.
scenes.say: Plan your time. Skim for the first minute. Then read carefully the parts the questions ask about. Always check each answer option against the text.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqtingizni rejalang. Birinchi daqiqada skimming qiling. Keyin savollar so‘ragan joylarni diqqat bilan o‘qing. Har bir javobni matn bilan tekshiring.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Main idea vs detail: remove test
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Birinchi: matnni skimming qiling, har so‘zni o‘qimang. Ikkinchi: mavzu gapi umumiy bo‘ladi va har doim ham birinchi emas. Uchinchi: asosiy g‘oya butun matnning fikri, tafsilot esa uni quvvatlaydi. To‘rtinchi: xulosa mavzu va asosiy fikrdan iborat bo‘lsin, o‘z so‘zlaringizda. Beshinchi: notanish so‘zni kontekstdan taxmin qiling. Shu usullar bilan har qanday matnni tez va aniq tushunasiz.
scenes.say: Today you learned to skim, to find topic sentences, to separate main ideas from details and to write a one-sentence summary. Well done!
scenes.say_uz: Bugun skimming qilishni, mavzu gapini topishni, asosiy g‘oyani tafsilotdan ajratishni va bir gapli xulosa yozishni o‘rgandingiz. Barakalla!

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz tanlagan taxminan uch yuz so‘zli inglizcha maqolani oling va uni uch gapda xulosa qiling. Reja: birinchi gap mavzu va asosiy g‘oya, ikkinchi gap eng muhim dalil, uchinchi gap natija. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: to‘liq gaplar, o‘z so‘zlaringiz, raqam va misollarsiz. Keyingi darsda tinglashda tafsilotlarni ushlashni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, take an article of about three hundred words and summarise it in three sentences, in your own words. Next time we will practise listening for details.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: taxminan uch yuz so‘zli maqolani o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan uch gapda xulosa qiling. Keyingi darsda tafsilotlarni tinglashni mashq qilamiz.

homework_uz: Taxminan 300 so‘zli inglizcha maqolani tanlang va uni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan uch gapda xulosa qiling: mavzu va asosiy g‘oya, eng muhim dalil, natija. Raqam va misollarni kiritmang. Keyingi darsda tinglashda tafsilotlarni ushlashni o‘rganamiz.

options: Reading quickly to get the general idea
quiz.why_uz: Skimming matnning umumiy fikrini olish uchun tez o‘qishdir.

options: Often first, but it can be elsewhere
quiz.why_uz: Mavzu gapi ko‘pincha birinchi, lekin ba’zan boshqa joyda bo‘ladi.

quiz.q: Which words usually introduce a detail?
quiz.why_uz: For example misol, ya’ni tafsilotni boshlaydi.

quiz.q: A sentence can be removed and the main point does not change. It is...
quiz.why_uz: Olib tashlaganda fikr o‘zgarmasa, bu tafsilot.

quiz.q: Which option is a typical wrong answer in a main idea question?
options: It is true but too small
quiz.why_uz: Noto‘g‘ri variantlar ko‘pincha to‘g‘ri, lekin juda tor bo‘ladi.

options: give the topic and main point in your own words
quiz.why_uz: Xulosa mavzu va asosiy fikrni o‘z so‘zlaringizda beradi.

quiz.q: You meet a new word while skimming. What should you do?
options: Keep going and guess from context
quiz.why_uz: Skimming paytida to‘xtamasdan, kontekstdan taxmin qilib davom eting.

quiz.q: A writer wants to give information. The purpose is...
quiz.why_uz: Ma’lumot berish maqsadi inglizchada to inform.

quiz.q: Which words are usually stressed in a spoken sentence?
quiz.why_uz: Ma’noli so‘zlar, ya’ni otlar, fe’llar va sifatlar urg‘u oladi.
